```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import yaml
from html import escape
from IPython.display import display, HTML

with open("content/customer_survey.yml", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}

survey = data.get("survey", {})
fine = data.get("fine_print", {})

def safe(value):
    return escape(str(value or ""), quote=True)

def link(value):
    url = str(value or "").strip()

    if url.lower().endswith(".qmd"):
        url = url[:-4] + ".html"

    if not (
        url.startswith("https://")
        or url.startswith("http://")
        or (
            not url.startswith(("/", "#"))
            and "://" not in url
        )
    ):
        return "#"

    return safe(url)

paragraphs = "".join(
    f"<p>{safe(text)}</p>"
    for text in fine.get("paragraphs", [])
)

html = f"""
<div class="cw-survey">

  <section class="cw-survey-card">

    <div class="cw-survey-card-heading">
      <span class="cw-survey-label">
        CUSTOMER FEEDBACK
      </span>

      <h1>{safe(survey.get("title"))}</h1>
    </div>

    <div class="cw-survey-card-body">

      <h2>{safe(survey.get("welcome"))}</h2>

      <p>{safe(survey.get("description"))}</p>

      <a
        href="{link(survey.get("button_url"))}"
        class="cw-survey-button"
        target="_blank"
        rel="noopener noreferrer"
      >
        {safe(survey.get("button_label"))}
        <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>
      </a>

      <p class="cw-survey-contact">
        {safe(survey.get("contact_before"))}
        <a href="{link(survey.get("contact_url"))}">
          {safe(survey.get("contact_label"))}
        </a>
        {safe(survey.get("contact_after"))}
      </p>

    </div>

  </section>

  <section class="cw-survey-fine-print">

    <div class="cw-survey-fine-heading">
      <h2>{safe(fine.get("title"))}</h2>
    </div>

    <div class="cw-survey-fine-content">

      {paragraphs}

      <p class="cw-survey-address">
        {safe(fine.get("contact"))}
      </p>

      <p>
        {safe(fine.get("paperwork_notice"))}
      </p>

      <p class="cw-survey-paperwork">
        {safe(fine.get("paperwork_information"))}
      </p>

    </div>

  </section>

</div>
"""

display(HTML(html))
```
